sn41.4:1.3: _Gokula_ is unique in early Pali. For the sense “milkshed” see Harivaṁśa Purāṇa 2.17.4; Bṛhatkathākośa 21.29–33.
sn41.4:2.3: Like the King of the Kurus at [mn82:28.1]().
sn41.4:3.1: Mahaka is unknown apart from this passage. The novice Mahaka of [pli-tv-kd1:52.1.2]() was a different person.
sn41.4:3.3: See CPD for abbha-sampilāpa. PTS dict wrongly reads samvilapa.
sn41.4:4.6: Text has _therā_ (plural) but this must be merely an artifact of the sandhi with _ti_, as in the previous line he is addressing a single monk.
sn41.4:6.9: By displaying a psychic power, Mahaka had stepped up to and perhaps over the line of behavior suitable for a mendicant. Perhaps he did not want to be seen as currying favor with an influential figure, like Devadatta ([pli-tv-kd17:2.1.12]()).
